newsitem.title: UK: Eurasia Mining has jv for Ural gold deposit.
newsitem.headline: Eurasia Mining has jv for Ural gold deposit.

text.p: Eurasia Mining Plc said on Wednesday that it had agreed to form a 50:50 joint venture with Yuzhuralzoloto (YUZ) to develop the Svetlinskoye gold deposit in the southern Urals region of Russia.
Eurasia said Svetlinskoye was a hydrothermal gold porphyry deposit where YUZ has done extensive drilling and has found a total mineral resource of 6,400,000 ounces of gold.
Yuz has identified an open pit reserve of 31.6 million tonnes averaging 2.30 g/t gold within this reserves.

Eurasia's managing director Andrew Counsell said: "Svetlinskoye is a world class gold deposit with potential to sustain long term production in excess of 200,000 ounces per annum and it represents an outstanding resource acquisition for Eurasia Mining".
The Svetlinskoye joint venture is one of a number of gold and platinum projects that Eurasia is developing in the Urals region of Russia.
